# wayscloud_vps_plans (Data Source)

Fetches the list of available VPS plans. Prices are returned in the customer's preferred currency.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `plans` (Attributes List) List of available VPS plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `cpu_cores` (Number) Number of CPU cores.
- `currency` (String) Currency code (e.g., `NOK`, `SEK`, `DKK`, `EUR`).
- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk size in gigabytes.
- `monthly_price` (Number) Monthly price in the customer's preferred currency.
- `name` (String) Plan display name.
- `plan_code` (String) Plan code for use in `wayscloud_vps` resource.
- `platform` (String) Platform type: `linux` or `windows`.
- `ram_mb` (Number) RAM in megabytes.
- `region` (String) Region code.
